summary: American Tower Corporation filed an 8-K to report a registered public offering of €750.0 million aggregate principal amount of 4.000% senior unsecured notes due 2033. Net proceeds of approximately €742.7 million (about $866.7 million) will be used to repay borrowings under its revolving credit facility and to redeem €500.0 million of existing 1.950% senior notes due 2026. The notes were issued under a base indenture dated June 2, 2025 with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. This is a routine debt financing and refinancing transaction, not a special situation.
